# Lifetime ISA or pension: which is worth more to me?

> Free UK Lifetime ISA vs pension calculator: per £1 of take-home pay, which pot is worth more at 60, for a first home or if you withdraw early, and the retirement tax rate or employer match where the answer flips. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
